blogs.title: LLMs Just Got a Massive Memory Upgrade: Meet LongRoPE
blogs.description: A high-level introduction to LongRoPE and its achievement of a 2-million-token context window. This post explains the significance of this milestone for AI agents and long-document analysis, translating the technical breakthrough into real-world possibilities like reading entire libraries in one prompt.

blogs.title: Beyond Linear Scaling: How Evolutionary Search Unlocks AI Memory
blogs.description: A deeper dive into the 'non-uniformity' of positional embeddings. This post explains why simple linear interpolation fails and how the researchers used a biologically-inspired evolutionary search algorithm to find the optimal way to scale rotary embeddings (RoPE) without losing critical information.

blogs.title: The Long Game: The Strategic Path to 2 Million Tokens
blogs.description: An exploration of the 'Progressive Extension' strategy. This post discusses the practical hurdles of training on ultra-long texts—such as data scarcity and GPU costs—and explains how LongRoPE uses a clever 'stepping stone' approach (fine-tuning to 256k then jumping to 2048k) to bypass these limits.

blogs.title: Stretching Without Snapping: Maintaining Precision in a Giant Context
blogs.description: Focusing on the 'Shorter Context Window Recovery' aspect of the paper. This post explains the 'crowding' problem that occurs when an LLM is stretched to millions of tokens and how LongRoPE ensures the model remains just as smart for short, 4k-token prompts as it is for massive datasets.
